cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You gave that violin peg a little turn, so I've given it a full one. I'll have you ready for the audition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tightened it until the string snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That string couldn't hold pitch. I've saved you a failure onstage; take that message to the panel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They heard it snap. They're asking whether you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I rejected an unreliable string. Ask for their spare violin; I'll check that one before I approve it.

reason: Make the borrowed misunderstanding concrete while preserving the Drive-specific response to each actual partner contribution. D18 retains useful original beats rather than replacing effective material unnecessarily.
